familyInclusionTests: Meaning or communicative force is not completely predictable from individual words.
Japanese conventionally prefers the recorded wording.
Register or social choice is materially important.
The item is a reusable communicative or substitution pattern.
The item is a conventional response, discourse organizer, or interactional formula.
exclusions: Register variants counted as separate families
Dialogue lines counted as separate families
Particles and inflection endings represented as Vocabulary links

reviewStages.responsibility: Automated extraction may identify candidates but cannot assign family, difficulty, or verification status.
An editor groups candidates, writes the rich record, checks authoritative references, and completes every gate except final publication.

A disclosed Japanese-proficient human or AI editorial reviewer performs a separate final pass over naturalness, meaning, reading, register, social suitability, examples, and substitution safety. AI review must be source-backed and identified as ai-editorial in metadata.
After sign-off, the record is marked verified, added to a checksummed production pack, and counted as a production family.

finalPublicationRequirements: Reviewer identity and reviewer type are disclosed in review metadata.
An AI sign-off is based on a separate record-level editorial pass and corroborating Japanese-language sources, not bulk extraction alone.
No unresolved family overlap or source-licence issue remains.
Production manifest counts and pack checksums validate.
verifiedLabelRule: The learner-facing Verified expression label is permitted only when every required gate has passed.
countingRule: Only distinct expression families count toward the 3000–5000 production target.
